_comment: Fixed GuitarSet benchmark list (jalon 1 of docs/polyphonic-plan.md). Do not edit by hand:
regenerate only if the rule changes, and re-score everything.
GuitarSet = 6 players (00..05) x 5 styles (BN, Funk, Jazz, Rock, SS) x 6 takes
(3 progressions x 2 tempo/key variants), each in a solo and a comp version.
For player p (0..5) and style index s (0..4, alphabetical order above), the 6 takes
of the (player, style) pair are sorted by name and indexed 0..5.
solo: player p takes styles (p + k) mod 5 for k = 0..3 -> 24 takes, 4 per player,
5 per style except SS (4); take index within the pair = (p + s) mod 6.
comp: player p takes styles (2p) mod 5 and (2p + 1) mod 5 -> 12 takes, 2 per player,
BN/Funk 3, Jazz/Rock/SS 2; take index within the pair = (p + s + 3) mod 6.
